```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gtExtras)
```

$$
H_{0} : \beta_{0} = \beta_{1} \quad  v\s \quad H_{1} : \beta_{0}\neq \beta_{1}
$$

To print out the cars dataset

```{r}
print(iris)
```

To know the data types of a particular variable

```{r}
class(iris$Species)
```

To change variable types

```{r}
new_dat$Species = as.character(new_dat$Species)
```

To confirm if the species variable data type is a character

```{r}
class(new_dat$Species)
```

To filter out observations where Sepal.Length \> 5 and Sepal Width \>3 where species is Setosa

```{r}
iris %>% 
  select(Sepal.Length,Sepal.Width,Species) %>% 
  print() %>% 
  gt() %>% 
  gt_theme_excel() %>% 
  tab_header(title = " Filtered ")
```

Editing data in R

```{r}
library(rhandsontable)
```

```{r}
rhandsontable(cars)

```

To highlight row2

```{r}
rhandsontable(cars) %>% 
  hot_row(row = 2 , readOnly = TRUE)
```

To move and resize coloumns in our data

```{r}
rhandsontable(cars) %>% 
  hot_cols(manualColumnMove = TRUE,manualColumnResize = TRUE)
```

To put a tooltip at row 1 ,col 1 and row2, col2

```{r}
rhandsontable(cars) %>% 
  hot_cell(row = 1,col = 1,comment = "This is the distance covered ")
```

Linear Regression

```{r}
mod <- lm(cars$speed ~ cars$dist)
summary(mod)
 
```

$$
E(Y/X) = 8.28391 \quad + \quad 0.16557x
$$

To predict when x = 14 ,15,16

```{r}
distance <- c(14,15,16)
pred <- data.frame(distance)
print(pred)

```

```{r}

predict(mod,pred)
```
